title: Benign consulting agreement that expressly does not renew
notes: Explicit non-renewal makes auto_renew false. Digit-led calendar-day notice may populate the numeric field. Nothing here warrants a high-severity flag.

clauses.span: Either party may terminate this Agreement for any reason by giving the other party 15 calendar days' written notice.
Each party's liability under this Agreement is limited to the total fees paid or payable under this Agreement, except for breaches of Section 6.
